summary: Frontend-only testing of the Sanidhya & Vasudha wedding invitation Page 1 (Wedding Chip) + Page 2 reveal flow. Verified transparent chip PNG, no black strips, outward radial signals, 4-quadrant tear animation, Page 2 reveal with all testids, replay, scroll unlock, and desktop + mobile viewports.

desktop_1920x1080.chip_quads_bg: all transparent, filter is warm gold drop-shadow (not dark)

test_results.console_errors: Only 1 unrelated Lenis warning about non-static container (pre-existing, out of scope). No image load errors, no page errors.

critical_code_review_comments: User-complaint about black rectangular strips/boxes around the chip is RESOLVED: the chip PNG is transparent, .chip-stage and .chip-scene both have transparent backgrounds, chip-quad drop-shadow is a warm gold (rgba(201,120,50,0.3)) not a dark shadow. Visual confirmation via desktop + mobile screenshots.
RadialSignals correctly radiates outward in all 22 directions from chip center (visible in activating screenshot).
4-quadrant tear animation triggers (phase progresses closed -> activating -> tearing -> done) and reveals Page 2 invitation hero flawlessly.
Minor: Lenis library prints a non-static container warning (pre-existing). Not caused by chip changes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Chip opening flow is stable. Phases take ~950ms (activating) + 1700ms (tearing). All Page 2 testids present. If re-testing, allow ~4s after chip-open-btn click before asserting invitation-hero.
